description: Groups of users with a role each (a team, a client), for rows that belong to a group: neblla.db.save(data, { table, group }). "list": the groups, or { group } its members; "of" { user }: their groups (user: the user id in the app, as neblla_list_users gives it). Changes nothing; neblla_group creates, fills and deletes groups.
name: neblla_group_read
title: Group (read)
